headline: 2HFY27E looks promising

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating BUY BUY Target Price 212 214 Sales (INR mn) 16,714 18,472 16,428 18,025 % Chng. 1.7 2.5 EBITDA (INR mn) 6,186 6,975 6,205 6,945 % Chng.

Led by same-store revenue growth of ~9-11%, addition of ~170 keys at Hyderabad and incremental contribution from the asset-light RARE India platform, we expect revenue CAGR of 14% over FY26-FY29E with EBITDA margin of 35.8%/37.0%/37.8% in FY27E/FY28E/FY29E, respectively.
SAMHI IN trades at an attractive valuation of 9.0x/8.3x our FY28E/FY29E EBITDA estimates (adjusted for minority interest in the JV platform with GIC).
We maintain BUY with a TP of INR212 (10.5x Sep-28E EBITDA; no change in target multiple).
